reduce-to-circuit:
(program (kernel-declaration (%kernel.5 () (Kernel)))
  (public-ledger-declaration
    ((%sealedDraw.4 (0) (__compact_Cell (tbytes 32)))
      (%drawn.0 (1) (__compact_Cell (tunsigned 65535)))
      (%open.1 (2) (__compact_Cell (tboolean)))))
  (native
    %persistentCommit.6
    ((%value.7 (tunsigned 65535)) (%rand.8 (tbytes 32)))
    (tbytes 32))
  (witness %winningNumber.9 () (tunsigned 65535))
  (witness %sealSalt.10 () (tbytes 32))
  (circuit %reveal.2
   ((%n.14 (tunsigned 65535)) (%salt.15 (tbytes 32))) (ttuple)
   (= %t.21 (public-ledger #t %open.1 (2) read))
   (= %t.22 (select %t.21 #t #f))
   (= %t.23 (select %t.21 #f #t))
   (= %t.24 (select %t.21 #f #t))
   (= %t.25 (select #t %t.24 #t))
   (assert %t.25 "already drawn") (= %t.26 (tuple))
   (= %t.27 (call #t %persistentCommit.6 %n.14 %salt.15))
   (= %t.28 (public-ledger #t %sealedDraw.4 (0) read))
   (= %t.29 (== %t.27 %t.28)) (= %t.30 (select #t %t.29 #t))
   (assert %t.30 "that is not the sealed number")
   (= %t.31 (tuple))
   (= %t.32 (public-ledger #t %drawn.0 (1) write %n.14))
   (= %t.33 (public-ledger #t %open.1 (2) write #t))
   (= %t.34 (tuple)) %t.34))
tell-constructor:
(constructor
      ()
      (seq (let* ([(%n.13 (tunsigned 65535)) (call
                                               %winningNumber.9)])
             (seq (assert (< %n.13 10000) "tickets run from 0 to 9999")
                  (let* ([(%tmp.16 (tbytes 32)) (let* ([(%n.17
                                                          (tunsigned
                                                            65535)) %n.13]
                                                       [(%salt.18
                                                          (tbytes 32)) (call
                                                                         %sealSalt.10)])
                                                  (call
                                                    %persistentCommit.6
                                                    %n.17
                                                    %salt.18))])
                    (public-ledger %sealedDraw.4 (0) write %tmp.16))
                  (public-ledger %open.1 (2) write #f)))
           (tuple)))
